text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "In Switzerland, nuclear energy is used solely for peaceful purposes, i.e. for producing electricity and for applications in medicine, industry and research.", "gist": "Switzerland uses nuclear energy only for peaceful purposes like electricity, medicine, industry, and research."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "May 1957", "gist": "Nuclear energy use started in Switzerland in May 1957"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "in view of the fact that the existing hydropower capacities were already largely exhausted", "gist": "Because hydropower capacity was nearly used up"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the Federal Council resolved to develop the use of nuclear energy", "gist": "The Federal Council decided to develop nuclear energy"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "1969", "gist": "Commercial nuclear energy use began in 1969"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Beznau I nuclear power plant", "gist": "Beznau I nuclear power plant was handed over for operation in 1969"}]}
